questions.question: In 2022, how many thousands of gallons of special fuel were used for private and commercial highway purposes in Texas?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_fuel_use_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MF-21', header=None)
tx_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Texas')].iloc[0]
result = int(tx_row[12])

questions.question: Which three states had the highest total motor-fuel consumption across all categories in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_fuel_use_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MF-21', header=None)
states = df.iloc[8:59].copy()
states[17] = pd.to_numeric(states[17])
top3 = states.sort_values(by=17, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].str.strip().tolist()
questions.check_program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_fuel_use_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MF-21', header=None)
# State rows are rows 8 to 58 (Excel rows 9 to 59)
data = df.iloc[8:59].copy()
# Total motor-fuel consumption across all categories is column R (index 17)
data[17] = pd.to_numeric(data[17])
top3 = data.sort_values(by=17, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].astype(str).str.replace(r'\s*\(\d+\)', '', regex=True).str.strip().tolist()

questions.question: Between New York and Florida, which state had a larger volume of combined gasoline and gasohol highway use in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_fuel_use_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MF-21', header=None)
states = df.iloc[8:59].copy()
ny_val = float(states[states[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'New York'][5].values[0])
fl_val = float(states[states[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Florida'][5].values[0])
result = 'New York' if ny_val > fl_val else 'Florida'

questions.question: How many states (including the District of Columbia) experienced positive year-over-year percentage growth in total highway fuel use in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_fuel_use_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MF-21', header=None)
states = df.iloc[8:59].copy()
pct_change = pd.to_numeric(states[14])
result = int((pct_change > 0).sum())

questions.question: What was the total non-highway use of gasoline and gasohol, in thousands of gallons, across all states that reported negative evaporation and handling losses in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_fuel_use_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MF-21', header=None)
states = df.iloc[8:59].copy()
losses = pd.to_numeric(states[10])
non_highway = pd.to_numeric(states[8])
result = int(non_highway[losses < 0].sum())

questions.question: In 2022, did Texas consume more total motor fuel across all uses than California?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_fuel_use_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MF-21', header=None)
states = df.iloc[8:59].copy()
tx_total = float(states[states[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Texas'][17].values[0])
ca_total = float(states[states[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California'][17].values[0])
result = 'yes' if tx_total > ca_total else 'no'
